message.content: The pain between my shoulder blades started two days ago. It was in one spot and didn't spread anywhere. After that my legs got weaker bit by bit until I couldn't stand, and then I started losing control of my bladder and bowels. I can't tell you exactly how many hours each step took. As for the risk factors, I haven't had any injury or heavy lifting. I'm not on blood thinners or any other medicines. I haven't had a fever or any recent vaccines, and I don't have any long-term illnesses. I wasn't asked about cancer or IV drug use, so I don't have anything to add on those.
